name: Serena
source:
Serena is a refined girl who maintains a consistent, ladylike persona. However, she is often misjudged as a snobby socialite, which impedes her ability to fit in with the rest of her peers. In addition to fitting in, Serena also struggles with her goals in life, as her mother—a recently retired Rhyhorn racer—wishes for her to pursue a career in racing. Unable to see herself with that type of life, Serena hopes to pave her own path, starting anew at Kobukan Academy.

Serena was first introduced in Pokémon X and Pokémon Y versions.
